biggest_catch: The top $825 tier requires $25,000 in deposits by day 30 and maintaining that balance through day 60. Business accounts only; new business checking customers only (one bonus per business, one per business owner in a 24-month period).
catches: Use the bonus offer code by November 10, 2026 when opening a new eligible Wells Fargo business checking account (Initiate, Navigate, or Optimize Business Checking).

Deposit $2,500 or more by day 30 from account opening; the balance on day 30 determines the maximum bonus ($2,500-$9,999 = $400; $10,000-$24,999 = $550; $25,000+ = $825). Additional funds after day 30 cannot raise the tier.
Maintain the account balance through day 60 (the qualification period); if it drops to a lower tier, the bonus is reduced or eliminated.
Complete 5 or more qualifying posted transactions within the 60-day qualification period.
Bonus deposited into the new business checking account within 30 days of meeting all requirements.

Offer for new business checking customers only: limit one business checking bonus per business and one per business owner within a 24-month period; not eligible if you currently own a Wells Fargo business checking account, closed one within the past 90 days, or are a Wells Fargo employee; non-resident aliens/foreign entities on Form W-8 excluded.
If Wells Fargo suspects misuse or abuse, it may close the account and rescind the bonus.
